content_paragraphs: I am applying for the Full Stack Developer opportunity on the Card Acquisition team because it combines the kind of work I most want to keep growing in: user-facing product development, full-stack feature ownership, and close collaboration across product, design, analytics, and engineering. Affirm stands out to me because this role directly connects technical execution with customer trust, acquisition, and long-term product growth, which makes the work both technically interesting and meaningfully important.

In my previous experience, I worked on full-stack product features across front-end interfaces, backend logic, and data-connected workflows in live business environments. A large part of my work involved translating business goals into usable interfaces, integrating APIs, supporting product changes safely, and improving systems over time based on real operational needs. That experience taught me that strong full-stack development is not only about shipping features, but also about making them understandable, measurable, and reliable for both users and the teams who maintain them.

One aspect of this role that especially appeals to me is the combination of growth work and engineering depth. I enjoy building user journeys that need to feel seamless and trustworthy, while also making sure the underlying implementation is maintainable, observable, and safe to iterate on. The opportunity to contribute to analytics, experimentation, and onboarding funnel improvements is especially exciting to me because it sits at the intersection of product thinking, user experience, and technical execution.

I am also drawn to the way this role works across the stack and across teams. I value environments where engineers partner closely with product managers, designers, and other developers to solve open-ended problems and deliver high-quality results incrementally. That kind of collaboration, along with the chance to keep learning technologies such as React Native, Python, and Kotlin in a production setting, is exactly the kind of challenge I am looking for.
I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my full-stack development background, user-focused mindset, and strong ownership to Affirm. Thank you for considering my application.
